chunks: Which guides to the right path; and we have come to believe in it, and will not associate any one with our Lord.
ai.seo_question: What did the Jinn say about the Quran's guidance and monotheism?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate the Jinn's superior spiritual perception, as they recognized the Prophet's (PBUH) mission even before many humans did. Their declaration of 'we will not associate any partner with our Lord' underscores the purity of Tawhid, a core tenet in Shia theology, distinguishing true monotheism from the polytheism prevalent in pre-Islamic Arabia.
